home_title: Qanooni masle mein ibtidai rehnumai, ghar baithe
home_lead: Agar aap wakeel ki fees nahi de sakte, to apna masla likhein, tracking number lein, aur verified volunteer wakeel ya free legal-help centre se muft ibtidai mashwara hasil karein.

home_what3: CNIC ya ghar ka pata zaroori nahi.
home_not1: Koi guarantee nahi: na case jeetne ki, na muft court representation ki.
home_not2: AI ya app wakeel ka mashwara nahi hai. Individual mashwara sirf verified wakeel deta hai.

emergency_title: Pakistan Qanooni aur Hangaami Madad Directory
emergency_intro: Hangaami madad, tahaffuz aur qanooni rehnumai ke liye seedha rabta. Call karne ke liye neeche mutaliqa helpline chunein.
emergency_safety_title: Abhi khatre mein hain? Aap ki hifazat sab se pehle.
emergency_additional_unavailable: Mazeed ilaqai rabtay load nahi ho sake. Bunyadi helpline directory upar maujood hai.
emergency_police_body: Foran police aur hifazati madad. Agar aap ya qareeb koi shakhs khatre mein hai to call karein.
emergency_rescue_body: Tibbi emergency, ambulance ki madad, aag bujhane aur rescue ki khidmaat.
emergency_rights_body: Muft qanooni mashwara, mutaliqa idaron tak rehnumai, gharelu tashaddud aur khawateen samait insani huqooq ki khilaf warzi par madad.
emergency_cyber_body: Online fraud, blackmail aur digital harassment National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency ko report karein.
emergency_child_body: Bachon par tashaddud, la-parwahi ya khatre mein kisi bache ki report karein. Foran madad ke liye soobai child protection service se rabta karein.
emergency_legal_body: Kam wasail rakhne walon ke liye muft qanooni mashwara aur legal aid ki rehnumai. Wakeel ki numaindagi ki sharaait maloom karein.

new_safe_time_hint: Jaise: shaam 6 se 8. Aap ke ghar mein koi dekhta ho to waqt soch kar likhein.

room_chat_closed: Chat tab shuru hoti hai jab wakeel request qubool kar le (aur request khuli ho).

slots_empty: Abhi wakeel ne koi khali waqt nahi diya.

lv_wait_pending: Aap ki arzi mil gayi. Verification tak intezar karein.
lv_wait_rejected: Aap ki arzi radd hui. Admin se rabta karein.
lv_wait_suspended: Aap ka account mua'attal hai. Admin se rabta karein.
lv_avail_hint: Slot sirf wohi book hote hain jo aap yahan dete hain.

co_revoke_confirm: Wakeel ka access foran band ho jayega. Hatayein?
co_ack_hint: "delivered" tabhi, jab centre ne asli tasdeeq di ho.
ad_no_lawyers: Is halat mein koi arzi nahi.

ad_suspend_confirm: Is wakeel ka access aur saare cases foran wapas ho jayenge. Mua'attal karein?
ad_contacts_hint: Sirf official source se tasdeeq shuda numbers. Foran madad ke numbers par "emergency" ka nishan lagayein.

home_ai_body: Apne alfaaz mein sawal likhein. Jawab sirf verified qanooni documents se aata hai, safha ke hawale ke saath.
home_intake_title: Ibtidai madad ke liye case bhejein
home_intake_body: Apna masla likhein, tracking number lein, aur sirf apni ijazat se verified volunteer wakeel ke saath share karein.
home_help_body: Foran bank ko ittila dein, saboot mehfooz rakhein, aur National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA) ko report karein.
home_help_note: National helplines official sources se check kiye gaye hain. Foran khatre mein 15 ya rescue 1122 call karein.
ai_history_hint: Tareekh sirf is session mein rehti hai; sawal server par mehfooz nahi hote.
ai_empty_body: Jawab sirf admin-verified documents se aata hai, aur har jawab ke neeche us ka hawala hota hai.

home_feature2_body: Har wakeel ki shakhsiyat aur registration admin official record se check karta hai.
home_feature3_body: Verified qanooni documents se ibtidai maloomat, aur online fraud ke liye 15 qadam ki checklist.

intake_disclaimer_note: Aap ka bayan mehfooz hota hai. Faisla sirf adalat ya mutalliq idara karta hai.
new_lead: Apna masla apni zubaan mein likhein. Jitni tafseel denge, utni behtar rehnumai milegi.
dash_empty_hint: Pehla qadam: apna masla likhein. Tracking number milne ke baad aap us ki halat dekh sakte hain.
legal_lead: Verified qanooni documents se ibtidai maloomat. Yeh aap ke masle par qanooni mashwara nahi.
legal_assistant_hint: Jawab sirf un documents se aata hai jo admin ne source aur tasdeeq ke saath darj kiye. Har hawala card mein safha aur source ka link hota hai.
legal_question_hint: 5 se 1000 harf. Email, phone aur CNIC jaise number bhejne se pehle hata diye jate hain.
legal_question_short: Sawal kam az kam 5 harf ka likhein.

legal_consent_hint: Ijazat ke bagair sawal bahar nahi jata; app sirf maujooda verified sources mein dekhti hai.
legal_typing: Verified sources mein dekha ja raha hai...
legal_no_match: Verified sources mein jawab nahi mila
legal_sources_empty: Abhi koi verified qanooni document darj nahi.
legal_sources_hint: Sirf woh documents jin ka source aur tasdeeq admin ne check ki.
scam_lead: Paisa ya account fraud ho jaye to foran amal karein. Har qadam par waqt aur reference number likhein.
scam_note: Yeh ibtidai rehnumai hai, qanooni mashwara nahi. NCCIA ya bank ka number hamesha official source se check karein; emergency directory mein sirf admin-verified numbers dikhte hain.
scam_step_1: Fraud karne wale se rabta band karein aur mazeed paisa na bhejein.
scam_step_2: Apne bank ya wallet ko foran call karein aur card/account block ya freeze karwayein.
scam_step_3: Bank, email aur social media ke password badlein; jahan ho 2-step verification on karein.
scam_step_4: Saboot mehfooz karein: screenshots, transaction ID, messages, call logs aur website ka link.
scam_step_5: Tareekh, waqt, raqam, IBAN/wallet number aur fraud karne wale ki ID likh kar rakhein.
scam_step_6: Bank ke fraud desk ko likhit complaint dein aur complaint number lein.
scam_step_7: NCCIA (cyber crime) ki official complaint portal ya helpline par report darj karein; ticket number sambhal kar rakhein.
scam_step_8: Agar paisa kisi wallet, agent ya online platform se gaya, to us provider ko bhi likhein.
scam_step_9: Agar kisi ne bank ya sarkari idare ka jhoota name istemal kiya, to asli idare ko bata kar incident reference lein.
scam_step_10: Apne email, SIM aur bank alerts check karein; koi naya login ya SIM badalna nazar aaye to foran report karein.
scam_step_11: Jo log 'paisa wapas dilwane' ke liye pehle advance fee mangte hain, un se bachein; yeh doosra scam ho sakta hai.
scam_step_12: OTP, PIN, password ya CNIC kisi ko na dein, chahe woh bank, police ya sarkari afsar batae.
scam_step_13: Agar CNIC ya documents leak hue hain to un ka istemal check karein aur mutalliq idare ko likhit ittila dein.
scam_step_14: Bank aur NCCIA ke saath follow-up rakhein; har reference number aur jawab ki copy rakhein.
scam_step_15: Muft ibtidai qanooni madad ke liye Insaf Dastak par request likhein ya verified helpline se rabta karein.
emergency_lead: Agar aap ya koi aur abhi foran khatre mein hai, to app ka intezar na karein: Police (15) / Rescue (1122) ko call karein, ya screen se foran nikalne ke liye upar laal "Screen chhupayein" button dabayein.
emergency_note: Ilaqai coverage aur auqat ke liye diye gaye idaron ke sources dekhein; dastiyabi soobay ke mutabiq farq ho sakti hai. Qanooni madad ki helplines police ya tibbi emergency ka badal nahi.

dash_how_1_body: PDF ya text file ek knowledge base mein shamil hoti hai. File aur us ke vectors aap ke account se jure rehte hain.
dash_how_2_body: Text ko overlapping chunks mein tora jata hai aur har chunk ko vector embedding banaya jata hai.
dash_how_3_body: Aap ka sawal embed ho kar sirf aap ke apne chunks se compare hota hai. Doosre users ka data kabhi search nahi hota.
dash_how_4_body: Model sirf retrieved passages se jawab deta hai aur apne sources dikhata hai. Agar kuch match na ho to jawab banane ke bajaye saaf kehta hai.
dash_audit_note: Login, upload aur admin actions jaise security events server audit log mein record hote hain. Admin accounts tafseel dekh sakte hain; yeh screen sirf summary dikhati hai.
dash_filter_empty: Aap ki search se koi knowledge base match nahi hui.
dash_urgent_hint: Foran madad ya fraud checklist chunein. Agar aap khatre mein hain to local emergency services se rabta karein.

byok_hint: Server par encrypted save hoti hai aur save hone ke baad masked dikhti hai. Chat ya audit logs mein kabhi nahi jati.
byok_clear_confirm: Kya apni saved Gemini key hatani hai? Agar shared key set hai to requests usay istemal karengi.
byok_saved: API key save ho gayi. Ab yeh masked dikhegi.
byok_note: Aap ki key encrypted save hoti hai aur sirf aap ki apni RAG requests ke liye istemal hoti hai. Kabhi poori nahi dikhayi jati.
